text:
olivia: Heads-upwe're starting the quarterly least-privilege sweep next week. Main goals: ownerproof for svc accts, KMS cross-account grants audit, and make sure audit-logs are immutable before changes. Need quick owners and a canary plan.
kevin: I can own ownerproof scripts. last time we matched last_used + token-issuance patterns. I'll reuse that.
tara: I volunteer to run KMS grant discovery. quick command: `aws iam list-policies --query 'Policies[?PolicyName==`"KMSGrant*"`]'` then CloudTrail lookup for Grant* events.
sec-bot: Added checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/least-privilege-checklist (auto-posted) :white_check_mark:
raj: question: do we treat delegated infra keys as exempt? we have service keys intentionally shared across accounts. propose a scoped whitelist file with justification and TTL.
nick: agree whitelist with TTL. also request we tag any removed binding with a remediation ticket so rollback is trivial.
olivia: proposed cadence: scan Mon, triage Tue, canary PR Wed (10 non-prod svc accts), monitor 72h, then broader apply next Tue. objections?
kevin: add step to snapshot current IAM and KMS policies to S3 with versioning and encryption. `./tools/snapshot_policies.sh --out=s3://redwood-audit/backups/q{quarter}`
tara: KMS discovery snippet I use:
```
aws kms list-keys --profile prod --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms list-grants --key-id {} --profile prod
```
sec-bot: Policy note: ensure `kms:ReEncrypt*` and `kms:Decrypt` are logged. See policy v2.1 diff: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-audit-v2.1.md
raj: Canary PR template idea: change only non-prod role bindings, add `remediation:revert-if-fail` label, require 2 approvers for high-risk roles.
nick: I'll create GH issue and attach initial CSV from scans. who runs scans?
olivia: kevin will run ownerproof and tara will run KMS scans. Kevin/Tara pls post CSVs to GH #4987 by Tue EOD.
kevin: running ownerproof Tue 09:00 PT. using filter: role like '%admin%' OR role in ( 'org-admin','billing-admin' ) AND last_used_at < now() - interval '90 days'.
tara: running KMS discovery Tue 11:00 PT. I'll produce infra_whitelist.json with fields: key_arn, justification, owner, expiry.
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule maintenance window if applying changes to non-prod accounts.
raj: also add a step to run the access-lint tool with `--explain` to capture why each entitlement exists (for manual triage).
kevin: good call. `./bin/access-lint --scope=prod --roles='*admin*' --explain > explain.csv`
nick: I'll set up the canary PR template and add CI that runs smoke auth tests. if smoke fails, auto-revert label triggers revert script.
olivia: rollback plan: 1) Re-add bindings via snapshot, 2) open incident if unexpected auth failures in prod, 3) postmortem.
sec-bot: Don't forget to rotate any temporary keys created during remediation and to keep KMS key policies unchanged except where explicit.
kevin: one more: export CloudTrail events for affected principals for last 90d into the GH issue for evidence. command: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=svc-foo`
tara: noted. I'll include CloudTrail filters per key.
raj: final ask: require at least one infra eng and one sec eng in approvers when touching billing/admin roles. add to template.
olivia: done. owners: kevin(ownerproof), tara(KMS), nick(canary PR+CI), raj(approval policy). meeting Thu to check progress. thanks.
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder in #eng-security for Tue 08:55 PT (scan kick-off).
